title: Crestline Fleet Account Tire Work Credit on Mobile Visit Fees
content:
When a mobile service crew's visit to a Crestline Fleet Account yard comes with tire work, a tire work credit is taken off the fee the contested visit owes.

| Tire invoices dated the visit day from the store that sent the crew | Tire work credit |
|---|---|
| four or more | 10.00 |
| two or three | 5.00 |
| fewer than two | nothing |

The tire invoices are the fleet invoices of the account in the tires service category whose invoice date is the visit day (the date of the visit fee invoice) and whose servicing store is the store that sent the crew (that invoice's servicing store).

## Boundaries

- 1 tire invoice: no credit; 2: 5.00.
- 3 tire invoices: 5.00; 4: 10.00.

The fee owed is never below 0.00, the floor being applied once after every addition and credit, not to each amount in turn.
